entityDescription:
Più Sviluppo was founded in 2010 by Francesco Marchis. The
company’s mission is based on the fundamental belief that it is necessary to
create “Development” (hence, sviluppo
in Italian) for the business system, in order to give value to their ideas and
their business.



Più Sviluppo model is based on the concrete paradigm of “doing”,
and allows companies to attract and aggregate all the necessary skills for the
development of a complete business project from the start and in a fast way,
limiting investments through the transformation in equity of the contributions
provided to the project be them workforce, tangible or intangible assets.



Each company is unique, and as such it must always be
treated and managed. This is why Più Sviluppo method cannot be standardized. In
this way, Più Sviluppo solves concrete problems, simplifying bureaucracy,
certifying companies according to regulations, finding non-refundable resources
and managing innovation, in a logic oriented towards results and objectives.


In the last years Più Sviluppo devoted itself to
gather competencies in order to tackle projects in the fields of production
automation, e-learning, satellite-based telecommunications and others.

entityDescription:
ACIF-CCIM (Industrial and Commercial Association of Funchal - Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Madeira) is a business association and also Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Madeira Archipelago. It is a private and non-profit multisectoral Association, founded in 1836.
ACIF-CCIM represents employers and companies acting in Madeira Island, defending its interests. As Economic Partner, our action is directed at up-holding the free competition between companies.
This Association has about 800 associated companies, from all sectors (commerce, industry, services and tourism) most of which are SME. To better protect the interests of its members and provide services according to their needs, ACIF-CCIM has 17 employees in addition, spread over six departments (Events and Communication; Training and Projects; Associates and Partnerships; Legal; Administrative and Financial; ICT).
ACIF-CCIM is responsible for developing a variety of activities, in particular a wide range of business services, including information and support for businesses; vocational training; company missions; fairs; conferences; events; representation and defend of the interests of its members; reinforcing the role of business associations on both national and international levels, among others.
We have developed, over the years, several projects for companies, with particular emphasis on pioneering initiatives in the tourism sector - particularly in the area of energy efficiency, training-consulting, e-commerce and applications for mobile devices, trade and services, among others. They were co-financed in several funds like EEA Grants, CIP, Interreg MAC, Interreg Atlantic Area, COSME, H2020 and Structural Funds.
With regard to our participation in European networks ACIF-CCIM began its experience in 1989 with Euro Info Centre and has continued in 2008 as Enterprise Europe Network partner, until now. ACIF-CCIM has also represented in Madeira Europe Direct network.

entityDescription:
Fly4Future company designs new technologies of aerial robotics and searches new ways of applying AI technologies onboard of unmanned systems. Our expertise includes precise control of unmanned systems, trajectory planning and following, operation in GPS and GPS denied environment, flying in indoor, outdoor and transition between these environments, onboard sensors fusion, environment mapping, scanning, and 3D modelling. In particular, we design technologies of autonomous take-off and precise landing from/on moving vehicles, cooperative deployment of multiple systems, precision agriculture, security applications, autonomous reconnaissance and surveillance. Representatives of Fly4future company have a long-term experience with R&D projects of drone research and development, including H2020 EU projects, EU operational program projects, Czech Technology agency projects, Czech science foundation, Czech ministries of Industry and Trade, Education, and Culture projects.

Two main business pillars of Fly4Future company are 1) Development and prototyping of autonomous aerial systems, and 2) Customized platforms for UAV research and development. 

In the first pillar, Fly4Future designs and develops autonomous drone systems specialized for particular needs of individual industrial end-users. Our solutions enable to deploy aerial robots in demanding outdoor and indoor workspace. Using onboard artificial intelligence, advanced computer vision, predictive control, and cutting-edge sensors and effectors, our aerial robots can be deployed close to obstacles in various tasks including even physical interaction with the environment. We offer a complete chain from a proof of concept of the most innovative ideas in cooperation with leading universities, over development of prototypes using state-of-the-art technologies, into a final product for your business.

Examples of autonomous drone applications we are focused on are:
Autonomous reconnaissance and surveillance,
precision agriculture, animals' localization,
security applications, convoys protection, moving objects pursuing,
aerial inspection of buildings interiors and industrial infrastructure,
inside inspection of pipelines, underground mines, caves, 
autonomous take-off and landing on moving vehicles (cars, boats, trains),
operation in GPS and GPS denied environment and transition between these environments,
precise control of unmanned systems using onboard sensor fusion,
environment mapping, scanning, and 3D modelling etc.

In the second pillar, Fly4Future builds unmanned aerial vehicles and systems of multiple aerial vehicles suited for requirements of research teams at universities as well as private companies worldwide. Our solution enables to integrate set of sensors of your choice into a ready-to-fly system accompanied with realistic simulators. To achieve maximally open and flexible research platform, our flagship products rely on open source controllers and ROS, but other systems can be integrated on request too. The key components of the delivered systems include precise control, onboard mission planning and multi-robot communication which makes possible to use the provided solutions for verification of multi-UAV and swarm robotics research. If required, we offer on-site training, assistance with experiments and even realization experiments on demand with our hardware. 

Our platforms are ready-to-fly to verify research achievements in the field of:
Swarms and multi-robot systems, visual tracking, navigation and learning,
deep learning and adaptive systems,
localization and mapping,
human-aerial robot interaction,
aerial manipulation, environment interaction, and grasping,
indoor navigation and localization,
field outdoor deployment in demanding conditions,
tactile and force sensing,
heterogenous UAV-UGV and UAV-AUV teams,
perception, onboard sensors verification, sensor fusion,
UAV control and state estimation etc.

Czestochowa University of Technology (CUT) is the largest state university in the region funded in the 40's last century. It is also the only one having full academic rights, i.e. it has the right to confer the title of doctor and university professor (habilitated doctor) . During its scientific and educational activities, it has become an inherent part of Poland’s history and tradition, of Czestochowa region and the city itself. In nationwide rankings of the state institutions of higher education, we are among the top universities in Poland of a similar profile.
CUT has a reputation for being a modern and well-equipped school which offers a wide range of courses and a high level of education. The excellent quality of our teaching and research and the unrivalled academic knowledge and experience of our academic staff make studying at CUT a stimulating and invaluable experience. The University also prides itself on having good student infrastructure, a wide range of high-standard laboratories and lecture rooms to support research and teaching as well as three halls of residence, its own publisher and a modern main library and faculty libraries.

entityDescription:
The Istituto per le Tecnologie Didattiche (ITD) is one of the research institutes of the Italian National Research Council. The institute is devoted to the study of educational innovation brought about through the use of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT). The research undertaken focuses on:
- the integration of ICT in various educational settings (school, university, business)
- issues related to different disciplines and themes (humanities, sciences, environmental education, etc.)
- learning issues of particular social significance (disability, learning difficulties, social disadvantage, intercultural issues, etc.)
- the study of technological innovation as a learning resource.
The main areas of reference for the Institute's research work are the cognitive sciences, computer science and the pedagogy of the various disciplines.

entityDescription: Telenavis S.A is a Greek SME, established in October 2000 in Athens, with the mission to provide innovative location intelligence, by developing software solutions that utilize the technologies of the global positioning through satellites (GPS, Galileo), the internet in the broad definition of connecting all the devices, the telematic devices and their wide range of sensors, and finally the smart phones as a way of connecting people. Telenavis S.A is a dynamically active company in the field of Geographic Information Systems and develops its activities in three main areas: • Digital Mapping. The aim is the collection, quality control and the digital imprint thus recording the information concerning the geography of Greece using advanced image sensing satellite technologies, etc. • Software development. The company utilizes its extensive experience and highly qualified executives to incorporate geographic data into applications for businesses and individuals. • Development of specialized applications. To provide efficient services to customers who want to have an integrated solution, Telenavis SA designs and implements cutting-edge desktop and mobile applications that meet the customer’s needs in all aspects of geographic information. Telenavis has developed a number of different products and services, introducing new ways for planning and executing everyday business in logistics, in salesforce automation, in service providers, in Municipalities. Our clients cover different sectors, like: Fast Moving Consumer Goods, Logistics, Retail Companies, Transportation, Banks, Telecommunications, Utilities, Pharmaceuticals, Public and Local Authorities. The main products and services are: 1. TLP – Telenavis Logistics Platform A platform that covers the freight transportation from planning to execution, collaborative, providing full visibility during the total journey. 2. SRP – Telenavis School Route Platform. A platform for planning monitoring and executing the everyday journey to school and back, providing information to parents. 3. GIS Services (Geomarketing, Site Selection, Web Mapping). Big data analytics on maps. 4. Telenavis SmartCity Platform. A platform that supports local governments to plan and manage their areas, assets and services, and communicate with their citizens. The majority of the workforce at Telenavis SA holds degrees and postgraduate titles in innovative technologies, telecommunications, telematics and geographical information systems.

entityDescription:
TerrAria srl was established in 1999 in Milan with the aim to join IT
(Information Technology) with environmental expertise. TerrAria currently
consists of close-knit and multidisciplinary team of 20 employees with
articulated competences (IT experts, computer engineers, physicists,
environmental and energetic engineers and urban planners) and able to provide
expert consultancy to Public Authorities, Research Facilities and private
operators about environmental and energy planning, strategic and impact
assessments and design and development of ad hoc sw-applications, through a
long-term approach oriented to environmental, economic and social
sustainability. Since its founding, TerrAria has increased employees and
turnover with a constant growth rate to current 20 employees and 1500 k € of
turnover.
TerrAria is organized in three Business Units:
(1) Software design and development: giving
priority to open-source software development, TerrAria is a leader in developing
WebGIS solutions and J2EE applications based on complex systems that manage and
provide information with business intelligence and databases (Oracle,
PostgreSQL, MySQL...) 
(2) Governance and environmental and
energy-environmental models: evaluates the interaction between project
scenarios and environment, through the implementation of forecasting models and
energy-environmental balances.
(3) Research and Development: due to its own
multi-knowledge attitude, TerrAria is often involved in research and development
projects, both as coordinator, partner and subcontractor. The most recent
research and development projects co-founded by EU or Regional funds are:
IRIS-LIFE project to improve the resilience of industry sector to climate
change (http://www.lifeiris.eu/en/), 
UTAQ an Urban Tool for Air Quality a CAMS-ECMWF use case,
SIMULATOR-ADS a regional/EU FESR funding an IT-platform to support the Civil
Protection prevention and preparedness also through satellite images 
TerrAria is a dynamic and smart company that over time has been able to develop the
skills and the company's business thanks to a high-level expertise and through
an innovative mission that allows to understand the market needs in advance.
Here below other elements are listed that identify TerrAria as an innovative
and cutting-edge company:
- since 2016 TerrAria has entered into the special section of the Commercial
Register of companies as innovative SME
- TerrAria, belongs to two Lombardy Region clusters: Cluster for Smart cities and 
Communities (currently being in the Board) and Lombardy and Energy
Cleantech Cluster, both promoting research and innovation, in order to
design, develop and implement the most advanced technological solutions
for the integrated management urban-scale systems and underground.

Established in 1988, ORION started its activity in the market of industry and environment automation. Continually involved in the search of excellence, ORION enjoys market leadership in the design, project engineering, production and sales of environmental continuous monitoring systems.
ORION, a UNI EN ISO 9001 ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 certified company, supports the customer from concept to project engineering, commissioning, after sales service offering its highly qualified commercial and technical staff, in the market of:
• Air quality monitoring
• Emission monitoring and process analysis (CEMS)
• Water monitoring 
• Management and maintenance of networks, systems and equipments
• Management and validation of environmental monitoring data
• Research and development of new technologies
The production made by ORION includes complete and flexible mobile stations, stationary air quality /water quality, water survey and traffic pollution monitoring stations, emissions and process analysis systems, personalized management software, mobile stations to manage environmental emergencies.
Orion has around 100 employees and a turnover of approx. 12 million Euro.
Our market business is spread as follows: 50% regarding supplies and 50% service activities.

Odor monitoring that is a theme of increasing evaluation for the population and institutions.

entityDescription:
The Passive House Institute was established in 1996 as an independent research institute in Darmstadt, Germany. Having developed the concept of cost effective Passive Houses, the Institute has gathered many years of experience in the field of research, simulation, quality assurance, design, implementation, project support, monitoring and evaluation, training and dissemination in the field of Passive House buildings and deep retrofits (EnerPHit). Moreover, the Institute gives recommendations how the Passive House and EnerPHit Standards can be used as a universal basis for the implementation of high energy efficiency directives across the globe, for example, the Nearly Zero Energy Buildings (NZEBs).

Having been active since 1996 under the name of Passive House Institute Dr. Wolfgang Feist, the institute is currently transitioning its activities to a new legal form as an important step to successfully and sustainably continue its work in the future. Under the registered company name "Passivhaus Institut GmbH" (PHI), which is owned and run by long-term Passive House Institute staff, the same team of scientists, engineers and consultants is working to continue research, consultation, certification or dissemination activities to advancing the organizations fundamental goal of making the built environment more sustainable.

DAN R&I manage projects that include several kinds of devices able to collect physiological and environmental data in several different environments, including remote areas and with particular focus on extreme sports and activities. Our habitual areas of application are diving, high altitude and recently we also approached a first step of possible future applications in outer space.

entityDescription:
The Irish Centre for Emergency Management provides support in modern emergency planning. The centre covers each phase of the internationally approved major emergency paradigm. It has an all hazards approach and endorses agreed interagency mechanisms. It provides a benchmark for emergency planning, training and exercises and plans audit. It carries out research across the full spectrum of emergency management, risk analysis, planning and response.
The Irish Centre for Emergency Management was established to provide a unique facility in order to provide support in modern emergency planning. The centre covers each phase of the internationally approved major emergency paradigm. It has an all hazards approach and endorses agreed interagency mechanisms. It provides a benchmark for emergency planning, training and exercises and plans audit. It carries out research across the full spectrum of emergency management, risk analysis, planning and response. 
ICEM has a vast resource of expertise available to it from local and national organisations in Ireland including health care, defence, education, transport, security and law enforcement

Also the S-HELP project which was focused on the development of Decision Support Tools for Improving Preparedness and Response of Health Services Involved in Emergency Situations.
ICEM has provided consultancy to EU Projects, Office of An Taoiseach, national and local government etc.
ICEM has a fully equipped TV production studio and outside broadcast facilities, the ability to stream live in HD on protected websites, including password protection for access to viewing, events such as emergency management exercises, business presentations, etc. 
ICEM has produced emergency management training and training media for many local authorities, national government and EU projects, all media is recorded in HD and made available on memory sticks, DVD disks, Blu-Ray disks and also via a streaming protected server as required.

entityDescription:
D-Heart biomedical start-up was founded in 2015 thanks to the work of Nicolò Briante and Niccolò Maurizi, at the time two young students in the interdisciplinary environment of the Almo Collegio Borromeo of Pavia. Maurizi is a young doctor researcher in cardiology at the University of Florence. When he was sixteen, Maurizi was hit by a myocardial infarction. He decided to became a doctor and transform his problem into an opportunity. Thanks to the help and business expertise of his roommate, Briante, they created D-Heart, the first smartphone/tablet ECG device that combines the usability required by the patient and reliability of the ECG wanted by the doctor.
It allows to patients and health professionals to perform hospital-grade 8/12 lead ECGs in total autonomy and to send the exam to a telecardiology service active 24/7. In few minutes a cardiologist will report the exam and send the telereport directly to the smarphone/tablet of the user and via email. The ECG can also be shared with anyone (for example with your trusted physician) via email or WhatsApp or message.
